description: This file defines an API helper function for making REST API calls to a backend service. It includes methods for authentication (signup, login, me) and messaging (listMessages, postMessage).

methods.name: createApi({ baseUrl } = {})
methods.description: Creates an API object with methods to interact with the backend, including signup, login, getting current user info, listing messages, and posting messages.

methods.name: request(path, { method = 'GET', token, body } = {})
methods.description: Internal helper function to send HTTP requests to the backend, handling headers, request body, and response parsing.

ctags.name: request
ctags.pattern: /^  async function request(path, { method = 'GET', token, body } = {}) {$/
